title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 1,701–1,750 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: Traditional media and social platforms report news from different angles.
examples.zh: 傳統媒體與社群平台從不同角度報導新聞。

examples.en: Critical thinking helps citizens evaluate information presented in digital media.
examples.zh: 批判性思維能幫助公民客觀評估數位媒體呈現的各項資訊。

examples.en: Media coverage of the charity concert raised millions for disaster relief.
examples.zh: 媒體對慈善音樂會的廣泛報導為災後重建籌集了數百萬元善款。

examples.en: The economic growth report made front-page news headlines today.
examples.zh: 經濟成長報告成為今天各大報紙的頭版頭條新聞。

examples.en: Eye-catching headlines on the web often lure readers into clickbait articles.
examples.zh: 網路上搶眼吸睛的標題經常吸引讀者點擊誘導性文章。

examples.en: The famous rock band will headline the music festival this coming weekend.
examples.zh: 這支知名搖滾樂團將於即將到來的週末擔任音樂節壓軸主唱。

examples.en: Grandpa enjoys reading the morning newspaper while sipping hot tea.
examples.zh: 爺爺喜歡邊喝熱茶邊閱讀早報。

examples.en: Delivering the early morning newspaper was his first teenage part-time job.
examples.zh: 沿街派送清晨早報是他青少年時期的第一份打工兼職。

examples.en: You can read digital editions of the daily newspaper on your mobile tablet.
examples.zh: 你可以在平板電腦上輕鬆閱讀當日日報的電子數位版。

examples.en: This English learning magazine features interesting cultural stories.
examples.zh: 這本英語學習雜誌刊載了豐富有趣的文化故事。

examples.en: She subscribed to an interior design magazine to gather home decorating ideas.
examples.zh: 她訂閱了一本室內設計雜誌，為居家裝潢佈置汲取靈感創意。

examples.en: The doctor's clinic waiting room provides current news and science magazines.
examples.zh: 診所候診室為候診病患備妥了當期的新聞時事與科學雜誌。

examples.en: The national emergency alert was broadcasted to all mobile phones.
examples.zh: 國家級防災警報已推播廣播至全體民眾手機。

examples.en: The radio station will broadcast the live championship game tonight.
examples.zh: 廣播電台今晚將即時現場實況轉播總冠軍爭霸戰。

examples.en: Satellite networks broadcast international news twenty-four hours a day.
examples.zh: 衛星電視網一天二十四小時不間斷播送即時國際新聞。

examples.en: Switch the TV channel to watch the live baseball tournament.
examples.zh: 切換電視頻道以觀賞現場直播的棒球錦標賽。

examples.en: The Taiwan Strait is a busy international shipping and maritime channel.
examples.zh: 台灣海峽是國際上極為繁重繁忙的海運船舶航運海峽通道。

examples.en: Companies establish formal feedback channels to hear from valued customers.
examples.zh: 企業紛紛建立正式的溝通反饋管道，以傾聽重要顧客的心聲。

examples.en: Public Television Service (PTS) produces high-quality educational programs.
examples.zh: 公共電視（PTS）製作許多高水準的教育節目。

examples.en: The community center offers an after-school tutoring program for kids.
examples.zh: 社區中心為學童開辦了豐富充實的課後課業輔導計畫課程。

examples.en: Engineers program microcontrollers to regulate smart home appliances automatically.
examples.zh: 工程師編寫微控制器程式，以全自動調控智慧居家各類電器。

examples.en: The exciting movie was interrupted by three long commercial breaks.
examples.zh: 精彩的電影中途穿插了三段冗長的電視廣告。

examples.en: The bustling district is filled with vibrant commercial activity and restaurants.
examples.zh: 這處熱鬧的街區充滿了蓬勃繁榮的商業活動與各式美食餐廳。

examples.en: A humorous television commercial boosted the snack brand's sales overnight.
examples.zh: 一支幽默風趣的電視廣告讓該零食品牌的銷量一夜之間飆升。

examples.en: The mayor held a press conference to introduce new transport policies.
examples.zh: 市長召開記者會說明全新的大眾交通政策。

examples.en: Reporters crowded into the hotel ballroom for the director's press conference.
examples.zh: 各家記者蜂擁湧入飯店宴會廳，出席導演的新聞發布會。

examples.en: The tech executive answered critical questions calmly during the live press conference.
examples.zh: 科技公司高層主管在現場直播記者會上沉著冷靜地回答尖銳提問。

examples.en: The central city museum is open to the general public for free.
examples.zh: 市立美術館免費開放供一般社會大眾參觀。

examples.en: Health experts urged the public to stay hydrated during extreme heatwaves.
examples.zh: 衛生專家呼籲社會大眾在極端熱浪來襲期間務必隨時補充足夠水分。

examples.en: Opinion polls reveal what the general public thinks about educational reform.
examples.zh: 民意調查客觀呈現了一般社會大眾對於教育改革的真實看法。

examples.en: Education plays a fundamental role in creating a prosperous society.
examples.zh: 教育在打造繁榮和諧的社會中扮演根本基石角色。

examples.en: Aging population demographics pose new economic challenges for modern society.
examples.zh: 人口高齡化結構趨勢為現代社會帶來了全新的經濟與照護挑戰。

examples.en: She joined the university historical society to explore ancient temple records.
examples.zh: 她加入了大學歷史研究社團，深入探究古老宮廟的歷史文獻記載。

examples.en: Volunteering at community food banks is meaningful social service.
examples.zh: 在社區食物銀行當志工是極具意義的社會服務。

examples.en: Teenagers use social networking apps to share photos with their classmates.
examples.zh: 青少年普遍使用社群網路應用程式與班上同學分享日常精彩照片。

examples.en: Good communication skills are necessary for navigating varied social situations.
examples.zh: 良好的溝通應對能力是在各種不同社交場合游刃有餘的必備條件。

examples.en: Our local neighborhood community organized a weekend park cleanup.
examples.zh: 我們在地的社區鄰里組織了一場週末公園大掃除活動。

examples.en: A friendly community center provides dance classes and meals for seniors.
examples.zh: 友善親切的社區活動中心為銀髮長輩提供舞蹈課程與營養共餐。

examples.en: Neighbors foster a warm sense of community by looking out for one another.
examples.zh: 街坊鄰里守望相助、互相關照，營造出溫馨濃厚的社區凝聚力。

examples.en: The government introduced subsidies to encourage electric scooter purchases.
examples.zh: 政府推出補助方案以鼓勵民眾換購電動機車。

examples.en: Citizens expect the government to maintain public safety and economic growth.
examples.zh: 國民殷切期盼政府能全力維護社會公共安全並促進經濟繁榮發展。

examples.en: Local government agencies work around the clock during severe typhoons.
examples.zh: 地方政府各防救災機關在強烈颱風侵襲期間日以繼夜全力值勤應變。

examples.en: Check the official government website for reliable epidemic updates.
examples.zh: 查閱政府官方網站以獲得可靠權威的疫情最新資訊。

examples.en: Senior government officials inspected the newly completed harbor terminal.
examples.zh: 政府高級官員親赴現場視察即將啟用的嶄新國際海港客運碼頭。

examples.en: The referee made an official announcement confirming the game result.
examples.zh: 比賽執法裁判正式發表官方裁決聲明，最終確認了比賽成績。

examples.en: Health authorities advised people to wear masks during flu season.
examples.zh: 衛生主管機關建議民眾在流感高峰期間佩戴口罩。

examples.en: The professor is a leading international authority on semiconductor physics.
examples.zh: 這位教授是國際半導體物理研究領域首屈一指的權威大師。

examples.en: Police officers have legal authority to inspect suspicious vehicles on highways.
examples.zh: 警察依法擁有在各級公路上攔查可疑違規車輛的法定職權。

examples.en: Taiwan is widely recognized as a vibrant and open democracy.
examples.zh: 台灣被國際普遍公認為充滿活力且開放的民主政體。

examples.en: Freedom of speech and an independent press are key pillars of democracy.
examples.zh: 言論自由與獨立自主的新聞媒體是維繫民主制度的核心支柱。

examples.en: Citizen participation in community forums strengthens grassroots democracy.
examples.zh: 廣大公民熱心參與社區公共論壇，能扎實深化基層草根民主。

examples.en: Free and transparent voting is the cornerstone of democratic nations.
examples.zh: 自由且透明的投票是民主國家的核心基石。

examples.en: Peaceful transitions of power exemplify a mature democratic society.
examples.zh: 和平順利的政權轉移彰顯了一個成熟穩健的現代民主社會。

examples.en: Democratic decision-making inside student clubs encourages shared responsibility.
examples.zh: 學生社團內部採行民主決策模式，能激勵成員共同分擔責任。

examples.en: The presidential election took place smoothly on Saturday.
examples.zh: 總統大選在週六平穩順利地完成舉行。

examples.en: Election campaigns filled city streets with colorful banners and broadcast trucks.
examples.zh: 選舉宣傳活動讓市區大街小巷掛滿了繽紛旗幟並穿梭著宣傳車。

examples.en: She volunteered as an election observer to ensure fair ballot counting.
examples.zh: 她自願擔任投開票所監票志工，以確保計票過程公正公開。

examples.en: Every eligible citizen has the civic right to vote in elections.
examples.zh: 每位具資格的合格公民在選舉中均享有投票權利。

examples.en: Did you vote for the proposed neighborhood community budget yesterday?
examples.zh: 你昨天針對社區鄰里提議的公共預算案投下贊成票了嗎？

examples.en: The committee took a formal vote to approve the new park design.
examples.zh: 委員會進行了正式表決，以過半數票數通過了嶄新公園設計案。

examples.en: Eligible voters lined up patiently at polling stations to cast ballots.
examples.zh: 合格選民在投開票所前耐心排隊領票並投票。

examples.en: Young voters are increasingly concerned about environmental and housing policies.
examples.zh: 青年選民群體越來越深刻關注環境永續與居住正義相關政策。

examples.en: The televised debate helped undecided voters make their final choices.
examples.zh: 電視辯論會有效幫助尚未做出決定的中間選民做出最終抉擇。

examples.en: Stamp your chosen candidate stamp clearly on the paper ballot.
examples.zh: 在紙本選票上清楚蓋上您所選候選人的圈選印章。

examples.en: The secret ballot ensures that no one can pressure how citizens vote.
examples.zh: 無記名秘密投票機制確保沒有任何人能脅迫影響公民的投票意向。

examples.en: Election workers carefully removed ballots from the sealed wooden ballot box.
examples.zh: 選務工作人員小心翼翼地將選票自封緘完整的票箱中逐張取出。

examples.en: Candidates presented their urban development policies in the debate.
examples.zh: 各候選人在電視辯論會中各自闡述都市發展政見。

examples.en: Three excellent candidates applied for the senior software engineer position.
examples.zh: 三位實力出眾的應徵者爭取應聘高級軟體工程師的核心職缺。

examples.en: The candidate shook hands warmly with early morning market vendors.
examples.zh: 候選人在一大清早走進傳統市場，親切地與每位攤商熱情握手。

words.definition: 競選活動；社會運動；從事宣傳

examples.en: The environmental group launched a campaign to reduce plastic waste.
examples.zh: 環保團體發起了一場減少塑膠廢棄物的倡導運動。

examples.en: Volunteers worked long hours answering phones in the election campaign headquarters.
examples.zh: 志工們在競選總部長時間輪班值勤接聽熱心選民的來電。

examples.en: The health bureau launched an island-wide campaign promoting flu vaccinations.
examples.zh: 衛生局在全島範圍內發起宣導運動，積極鼓勵全民接種流感疫苗。

examples.en: The president greeted international diplomats at the Presidential Office.
examples.zh: 總統在總統府內親切接見各國外交使節。

examples.en: The university president delivered an inspiring speech at graduation.
examples.zh: 大學校長在畢業典禮上發表了一場鼓舞人心的精彩致詞。

examples.en: The board elected a new corporate president to lead the expansion into Asia.
examples.zh: 董事會推選出嶄新的企業總裁，全權主導開拓亞洲新興市場。

examples.en: The mayor visited flood-prone districts to inspect drainage upgrades.
examples.zh: 市長前往易淹水地區視察排水防洪改善工程。

examples.en: Citizens welcomed the mayor at the opening of the community sports center.
examples.zh: 社區運動中心盛大落成開幕時，市民熱烈鼓掌歡迎市長親臨剪綵。

examples.en: The mayor promised to expand bilingual education programs across local schools.
examples.zh: 市長承諾將在全市各級中小學全面擴大推動雙語教學實驗計畫。

examples.en: Lawmakers passed the child welfare protection bill unanimously.
examples.zh: 立法委員們一致無異議通過了兒童福利保護法案。

examples.en: Lawmakers debated heatedly over public transit budget allocations.
examples.zh: 立法委員針對大眾捷運公共建設的預算分配展開了激烈攻防辯論。

examples.en: Citizens wrote letters to local lawmakers urging stricter road safety penalties.
examples.zh: 熱心民眾紛紛致信給選區立委，呼籲應修法加重交通違規罰則。

examples.en: The city council approved the new metro construction budget.
examples.zh: 市議會審議通過了全新捷運建設的預算案。

examples.en: Members of the student council organized the annual autumn campus festival.
examples.zh: 學生自治會幹部一手籌劃並組織了一年一度熱鬧的秋季校園祭。

examples.en: The local advisory council meets every month to discuss urban zoning.
examples.zh: 地方都市諮詢委員會每月定期集會，深入探討市區土地重劃規劃。

examples.en: College students actively discuss current domestic and global politics.
examples.zh: 大學生們熱烈討論當前的國內與國際政治情勢。

examples.en: He majored in international politics at university before joining the foreign service.
examples.zh: 他在大學時期專攻國際政治學，畢業後順利考取外交領事體系。

examples.en: Navigating workplace politics requires emotional intelligence and clear boundaries.
examples.zh: 妥善應對職場政治生態，往往需要高度的情商與清晰的處事原則。

examples.en: Freedom of expression and assembly are fundamental political rights.
examples.zh: 言論自由與集會結社是憲法保障的基本政治權利。

examples.en: News analysts examined the economic impact of recent political developments.
examples.zh: 新聞評論員深入評析了近期政治局勢演變對經濟市場造成的連鎖效應。

examples.en: Diplomatic embassies observe political trends in foreign countries very closely.
examples.zh: 各國外交大使館皆極為密切地觀察派駐國當前的政局走向與趨勢。

examples.en: Taiwan has a dynamic multi-party democratic political system.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有充滿活力的多黨競爭民主政黨體系。

examples.en: We threw a surprise birthday party for our favorite teacher.
examples.zh: 我們為最受敬愛的老師舉辦了一場驚喜溫馨的生日慶生派對。

examples.en: Both legal parties signed the contract in the presence of an attorney.
examples.zh: 法律合約雙方當事人在執業律師的共同見證下正式簽署協議。

examples.en: The government announced a supportive bilingual education policy.
examples.zh: 政府公布了支持性的雙語教育推動方針政策。

examples.en: The hotel has a strict non-smoking policy enforced inside all guest rooms.
examples.zh: 這家飯店在所有客房內部皆實施嚴格的全面禁菸管理規定。

examples.en: Check the airline’s luggage refund policy before purchasing economy flight tickets.
examples.zh: 購買經濟艙機票之前，務必事先詳閱該航空公司的行李退費政策。

examples.en: Housing affordability is a pressing economic issue for young adults.
examples.zh: 青年購屋與租屋負擔能力是當前急迫的經濟議題。

examples.en: The post office will issue a series of commemorative cultural stamps next month.
examples.zh: 郵政總局將於下個月正式發行一套極具典藏價值的文化紀念郵票。

examples.en: Resolving climate change issues demands global collaboration and green innovation.
examples.zh: 妥善解決全球氣候變遷難題，極度仰賴國際跨國合作與綠能創新。

examples.en: In my opinion, practicing listening daily is key to learning English.
examples.zh: 依我個人的看法，每日練習聽力是學好英語的關鍵。

examples.en: Respect other classmates even when their opinions differ from your own.
examples.zh: 即使其他同班同學的看法與你不同，也應當予以充分的尊重。

examples.en: Public opinion strongly supports upgrading bike lanes and pedestrian sidewalks.
examples.zh: 社會公眾輿論強烈支持全面升級拓寬自行車專用道與行人安全人行道。

words.definition: 民意調查；投票；抽樣調查

examples.en: The latest opinion poll shows high public satisfaction with public transit.
examples.zh: 最新民意調查顯示民眾對大眾運輸擁有極高的滿意度。

examples.en: Research centers poll registered citizens over the telephone during campaign season.
examples.zh: 各研究民調中心在選舉期間透過市話與手機抽樣電訪合格公民。

examples.en: An exit poll was conducted immediately after voters left their polling stations.
examples.zh: 選民走出投開票所之後，民調機構立即在出口處進行了出口民調。

examples.en: The two mayoral candidates engaged in a live televised policy debate.
examples.zh: 兩位市長候選人進行了電視現場直播的政見辯論。

examples.en: Our high school debate team won the regional championship trophy.
examples.zh: 我們學校的高中英語辯論校隊奪得了區域錦標賽冠軍金盃。

examples.en: Lawmakers debated the healthcare funding bill for three consecutive days.
examples.zh: 立法委員針對全民健保預算改革法案連續激辯討論了整整三天。

examples.en: Everyone is equal before the law in a constitutional democracy.
examples.zh: 在憲政民主體制下，法律之前人人平等。

examples.en: Drivers who violate traffic laws face heavy fines and point deductions.
examples.zh: 違反道路交通安全法規的駕駛人將面臨高額罰鍰與駕照違規記點。

examples.en: Sir Isaac Newton formulated the fundamental universal laws of motion.
examples.zh: 艾薩克·牛頓爵士確立了奠定現代物理學基礎的萬有運動定律。

examples.en: The legal voting age was officially lowered to eighteen years old.
examples.zh: 法定投票年齡已正式依法調降至十八歲。

examples.en: The company consulted their legal advisor before signing the international partnership.
examples.zh: 該公司在簽署這份跨國戰略合作協議之前，先行徵詢了常年法律顧問。

examples.en: You have a legal obligation to declare all overseas income when filing taxes.
examples.zh: 依法納稅申報所得時，公民負有申報所有海外合法所得的法定責任。

examples.en: Riding a scooter on pedestrian sidewalks is strictly illegal.
examples.zh: 在人行道上騎乘機車是嚴格禁止的違法行為。

examples.en: Downloading copyrighted movies without authorization is completely illegal.
examples.zh: 未經正式版權授權而任意非法下載受著作權保護的電影是違法的。

examples.en: Customs officers confiscated thousands of imported cartons of illegal smuggled cigarettes.
examples.zh: 海關關務人員依法查扣了數千箱企圖非法走私入境的未稅菸品。

examples.en: Every child has the basic human right to receive free education.
examples.zh: 每個孩童都享有接受免費教育的基本人權權利。

examples.en: Double-check your calculation to ensure you have the right total answer.
examples.zh: 請再次仔細核算確認算式，以確保你計算出的最終總額答案完全正確。

examples.en: Turn right at the convenience store and walk straight for two blocks.
examples.zh: 在那家便利商店路口右轉，接著筆直向前步行兩個街區即達。

examples.en: Freedom of the press is vital for a transparent government.
examples.zh: 新聞媒體自由對於監督政府與透明施政至關重要。

examples.en: Freedom of speech allows diverse voices and perspectives to flourish safely.
examples.zh: 言論自由能保障社會上多元相異的聲音與觀點得以安全蓬勃發展。

examples.en: Many immigrants came to this new land in search of economic and religious freedom.
examples.zh: 許多移民不遠千里遷徙來到這片新土地，尋求經濟發展與宗教信仰的自由。

examples.en: Promoting gender equality creates a fair work environment for all.
examples.zh: 提倡性別平等能為所有人營造公平友善的職場環境。

examples.en: The modern constitution guarantees legal equality regardless of ethnicity or faith.
examples.zh: 現代憲法明文保障無論任何種族背景或信仰，人人皆享有法律上的平等。

examples.en: Educational equality ensures that children in rural areas enjoy quality schooling resources.
examples.zh: 落實教育機會均等能確保偏鄉地區的孩子同樣享有優質充沛的教育資源。

examples.en: The judicial court aims to uphold justice and fairness for all citizens.
examples.zh: 司法體系旨在為全體國民捍衛社會公平與正義。

examples.en: Victims of financial fraud demanded legal justice and proper restitution.
examples.zh: 金融詐騙案件的無辜受害者要求嚴懲罪犯，討回司法正義與合理賠償。

examples.en: Social justice advocates campaign to protect underprivileged groups from exploitation.
examples.zh: 致力於社會正義的倡議人士積極奔走，保護弱勢弱勢群體免遭不當剝削。

examples.en: The dispute was resolved peacefully inside the district court.
examples.zh: 這起糾紛在地方法院法庭內獲得了和平調解。

examples.en: Students booked an indoor basketball court for their weekend tournament.
examples.zh: 學生們預約了一處室內籃球場，作為舉辦週末班際盃球賽的場地。

examples.en: Witnesses must swear to speak the truth before giving testimony in court.
examples.zh: 證人在法庭上作證之前，必須莊嚴宣誓所言皆為毫無虛假的事實真相。

examples.en: The impartial judge listened carefully to testimony from both parties.
examples.zh: 公正無私的法官仔細聆聽雙方當事人的證詞。

examples.en: A panel of experienced pastry chefs was invited to judge the baking contest.
examples.zh: 大會特別邀請了一組資深甜點烘焙名廚，擔任本次烘焙大賽的專業評審。

examples.en: Don't judge a person’s character merely by their exterior appearance.
examples.zh: 評斷一個人的品德與為人，切勿僅憑其表面外貌就輕易妄下論斷。

examples.en: Helpful police officers patrol community streets day and night.
examples.zh: 熱心助人的警察日以繼夜巡邏社區大街小巷。

examples.en: A brave police officer helped an elderly lost tourist find her hotel safely.
examples.zh: 一位熱心勇敢的警員耐心地協助一位迷路年長遊客平安返回下榻飯店。

examples.en: Traffic police officers directed crowded vehicle flow when traffic lights malfunctioned.
examples.zh: 當十字路口交通號誌故障停擺時，交通警員冒雨在路口中央指揮疏導車流。

examples.en: You can report a lost wallet at the nearest neighborhood police station.
examples.zh: 您可以在最近的社區派出所報案申報遺失皮夾。

examples.en: Local police stations offer round-the-clock assistance and warm tea to citizens in need.
examples.zh: 地方派出所全天候二十四小時為有需要的求助民眾提供即時協助與熱茶。

examples.en: A red light glowing above the neighborhood police station entrance signals safety.
examples.zh: 社區派出所門口高高懸掛的紅燈籠標誌散發著令人心安的守護溫暖。

examples.en: Taiwan is globally recognized for its remarkably low crime rate.
examples.zh: 台灣以其極低的犯罪率在國際上享有極佳治安美譽。

examples.en: Installing security cameras along alleyways helps deter burglary and street crime.
examples.zh: 在巷弄周邊裝設監控攝影機有助於震懾竊盜與各類街頭犯罪行為。

examples.en: Financial cyber crime has become a serious threat requiring specialized digital forensics.
examples.zh: 金融網路犯罪日益猖獗，已成為亟需專業數位鑑識技術打擊的嚴重威脅。

examples.en: The police captured the fleeing criminal within twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 警方在二十四小時內成功將逃逸的罪犯緝捕歸案。

examples.en: Committing intentional fraud results in serious criminal charges and prison sentences.
examples.zh: 蓄意進行詐欺犯罪將面臨嚴厲的刑事罪名指控與實質有期徒刑。

examples.en: The convicted criminal was sentenced to community service by the presiding judge.
examples.zh: 審判長依法判處這名被定罪的犯人執行特定時數的社區勞動服務。

examples.en: Strict traffic lights and pedestrian crossings enhance road safety.
examples.zh: 完善嚴格的交通號誌與行人穿越道能增進道路安全。

examples.en: Construction workers must wear protective hard hats and safety boots on site.
examples.zh: 營建施工現場工人工作時必須全程配戴防護工程安全帽與防刺安全鞋。

examples.en: Food safety inspectors check restaurant kitchens regularly to prevent food poisoning.
examples.zh: 食品安全衛生稽查員定期抽檢餐廳廚房衛生，以防範食物中毒發生。
